Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly interpreted the data found by the WebSurfer in Step 10. The WebSurfer explicitly listed three distinct entries for the year 2009: "Cantora 1 (w/various artists)" and "Cantora 2 (w/various artists)". The Planner erroneously consolidated these two separate entries into a single "Cantora" album, reducing the count from 3 to 2. This was a data processing error where the Planner failed to count the individual rows presented in the source text, instead making an assumption about the nature of the double-album release that contradicted the explicit listing of two separate titles.
